scope: A local synthetic promotion CLI checks exact artifact identity and classification against an approved fixture contract on development-to-staging and staging-to-production edges, and emits serving Deployment metadata. Kubernetes v1.36.1 ValidatingAdmissionPolicy denies missing or changed classification and digest on one small production Deployment. Local payload bytes are synthetic, and their SHA-256 is validated and carried across both stages. No registry, provider, production signing, attestations, or governance process is exercised; trust in the release contract and its approval is out of scope.
